exclusion_policy.soccer/football: OLBG sport Football (id 1) excluded; includes all association football competitions incl. Champions League / Premier League rows seen on the All Sports page.
exclusion_policy.boxing_ufc_mma: OLBG sport Boxing (id 16) is the page OLBG uses for boxing and UFC/MMA fight cards; excluded.

ambiguities.issue: The exclusion list bans 'football' and 'hurling' but does not name Gaelic football. Read literally, Gaelic football is not excluded. It is treated as INCLUDED but every row is tagged ambiguous_exclusion=true so it can be removed with one filter.
Cycling is excluded but motor racing is a different sport and is not named in the exclusion list.
Horse racing is excluded; greyhound racing is not named in the exclusion list.

harvest_method.tool: agent page-retrieval (sandbox HTTP client cannot reach olbg.com; curl returns OpenSSL SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL / exit 35 - verified)
harvest_method.pages: https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips plus one page per allowed OLBG sport id
harvest_method.granularity: Rows are exactly what the OLBG listing rendered on first page at retrieval time. OLBG paginates ('Load More Tips'); rows beyond the first page were NOT captured and are flagged.
harvest_method.values_inferred: none - blank when not stated by the source

harvest_timezone_note: OLBG renders listing times in the viewer locale; for this fetcher that is US Eastern Daylight Time (UTC-4), checked against NHL and NBA official start times. Official UTC is stored in verifications.json where confirmed.
